prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: hit while turning left in Conroe, Texas. Injury: neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1111; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was turning left at an intersection in Conroe, Texas, when another vehicle struck the side of my car. I had slowed nearly to a stop and was waiting for a gap in oncoming traffic when the impact came. My car spun a quarter turn, and my head snapped forward and then back against the headrest. I have been in the same position with the same account each time I have described what happened, whether to the other driver, the responding officer, or my insurer. I am the named driver on this policy and I was operating the vehicle with the owner's permission. Since the collision I have had stiffness and pain in my neck, which my doctor diagnosed as a neck strain. I am submitting this statement so the claim can be reviewed and processed.
